Looking for a job that truly matters? Then you’ve come to the right place!
 

For a large industrial laundry company in Oedelem, we are looking for a motivated production worker. You will work in a two-shift system or day shift. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Sorting dirty laundry
 
• Hanging clothes/linen on hangers
 
• Placing clothes/linen on the steam ironing table
 
• Checking for wear and tear
 
• Based on your skills and competences, we will determine which production line suits you best. 

For the position of production worker, we are looking for someone with the following qualities:
 

 
• You can work independently
 
• You are able to perform physical work
 
• You can work in a two-shift system or day shift
 
• You speak Dutch, English, French, or another language
 
• You can travel independently to the depot in Oedelem

As a Salesforce Technical Lead Consultant, you lead the technical delivery of Salesforce projects from solution design to implementation. You work closely with consultants and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions.

You combine technical leadership with a hands-on approach. From supporting pre-sales and defining solution architectures to mentoring developers and contributing code yourself, you’re as comfortable presenting ideas in the boardroom as solving technical challenges in the codebase.

Experience with Salesforce architecture, integrations, and DevOps is essential. Professional proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Experience in life sciences, regulatory compliance, and data security is a plus.

Does this sound like the perfect fit?

For an international company in the port of Zeebrugge, we are seeking 100% EV Car Technicians.

In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, vehicle diagnostics, repairs, quality inspections, software updates, and more.

You have a very good knowledge of English (spoken/written).

You have a technical background in automotive (Level 3 EV certification   working experience).

You are IT literate, with capability to surf through different working tools, reporting systems, diagnostic tool, etc.?

You are communicative as you'll have to update colleagues (technical & non-technical) on the status of the vehicles.

You work organized as you will have to create reports to show results of the performed activities.

Primary Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and refine yeast extract-driven solutions for a variety of savory food applications, including soups, stocks, sauces, and snack flavoring systems.
 
• Drive recipe creation and continuous optimization to improve flavor intensity, enhance umami profiles, and achieve balanced taste performance.
 
• Perform sensory assessments and analyze evaluation results to support product development and strategic market positioning.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market insights into effective, scalable, and commercially viable formulations.
 
• Investigate ingredient functionality within complex food systems and resolve technical formulation issues.
 
• Carry out market intelligence activities, including competitive product reviews and emerging trend monitoring in savory applications.
 
• Provide technical support for customer projects through prototype development, problem resolution, and product demonstrations.
 
• Work closely with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to accelerate innovation initiatives and business growth.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory requirements, quality standards, and internal product development procedures.

Profile & Expertise

 
• Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
 
• Demonstrated expertise in product formulation and application development within one or more savory segments such as soups, seasonings, sauces, or bouillons.
 
• Outstanding junior professionals with strong academic achievements, internships, or relevant project experience are welcome to apply.
 
• Solid knowledge of sensory science, flavor characterization, and sensory-driven product development.
 
• Strong understanding of ingredient performance, flavor synergy, and behavior within food systems.
 
• Capable of planning and executing experiments independently while drawing meaningful conclusions from technical data.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on formulation improvement and optimization.
 
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external clients.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer and business needs.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
 
• Availability for occasional travel across Europe for customer meetings, industry exhibitions, and knowledge-sharing sessions at the company's headquarters in China.

Core Responsibilities

 
• Develop, refine, and enhance bakery solutions utilizing yeast-based ingredients, including baker's yeast, yeast extracts, yeast proteins, and other specialty baking components.
 
• Plan and conduct practical baking trials tailored to customer needs while aligning with current European bakery market demands and consumer trends.
 
• Lead recipe formulation and continuous product optimization for breads, viennoiseries, laminated pastries, and a wide range of fermented baked goods.
 
• Deliver technical expertise and customized product solutions to strategic customers and bakery manufacturers throughout Europe.
 
• Organize and perform bakery demonstrations in customer facilities, application centers, and industry exhibitions, both for individual clients and larger groups.
 
• Translate customer specifications and commercial opportunities into scalable formulations and effective technical recommendations.
 
• Partner closely with commercial, marketing, and global R&D teams to support innovation initiatives and business growth objectives.
 
• Monitor industry developments, competitor offerings, ingredient innovations, and advances in bakery processing technologies.
 
• Ensure all development activities comply with applicable regulations, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Professional Skills

 
• Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Baking Technology, Milling Technology, or a related field. Practical bakery training or hands-on experience as a baker is highly valued.
 
• Minimum of 5 years' experience in bakery product development, ideally within premix manufacturers, industrial bakeries, or yeast ingredient companies.
 
• Strong expertise in bakery ingredient functionality, dough behavior, flour performance evaluation, and process optimization.
 
• Proven ability to design trials, analyze technical results, identify root causes, and resolve formulation challenges.
 
• Hands-on and solution-oriented professional capable of working autonomously in a laboratory and application environment.
 
• Commercial awareness with the ability to transform technical expertise into tangible customer benefits.
 
• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working across departments and directly with customers.
 
• Excellent presentation and communication abilities, including delivering technical training sessions, demonstrations, and customer workshops.
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, for international collaboration; knowledge of French or Dutch is considered an asset.
 
• Flexible and willing to travel across Europe for customer meetings, trade fairs, and knowledge-sharing visits to the company's headquarters in China.

Key Responsibilities

 
• Design, develop, and enhance yeast-protein-based solutions for a range of food applications, including sports nutrition products, plant-based dairy substitutes, and baked goods.
 
• Drive recipe development and continuous prototype improvement to achieve targeted functionality, such as texture enhancement, emulsification, gel formation, and overall product performance.
 
• Analyze sensory evaluation results and transform insights into actionable recommendations for formulation refinement and product advancement.
 
• Perform competitive product assessments and monitor industry developments related to proteins and functional ingredients.
 
• Convert customer requirements and market expectations into effective technical concepts and scalable product solutions.
 
• Provide technical expertise for customer-focused projects, including prototype preparation, issue resolution, and technical demonstrations.
 
• Partner with commercial, marketing, and international R&D teams to deliver innovative products aligned with business objectives.
 
• Maintain adherence to regulatory guidelines, quality requirements, and internal research and development procedures.

Qualifications & Skills

 
• Master's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, or a closely related field.
 
• Demonstrated background in product formulation and application development within food systems such as sports nutrition, plant-based alternatives, bakery products, or similar sectors. Talented early-career candidates with relevant academic projects or internship exposure are welcome to apply.
 
• Strong expertise in sensory assessment, product characterization, and structured evaluation methodologies.
 
• In-depth knowledge of ingredient performance, protein functionality, and interactions within complex food matrices.
 
• Ability to independently plan trials, execute experiments, and draw meaningful conclusions from technical findings.
 
• Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities related to formulation challenges and product improvement.
 
• Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and engage with customers.
 
• Commercial awareness and the capability to translate technical innovations into business and customer benefits.
 
• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written, for international collaboration.
 
• Flexibility to travel for customer meetings, industry exhibitions throughout Europe, and knowledge-sharing activities with the headquarters in China.

As a Transport Officer you get to organize & control the transport of deliveries in order to achieve high standards of transport quality.
 

Responsibilities: 
 

 
• Organizing the collection of the finished order via the SAP transport module or entering the shipments in the relevant transport software
 
• Communicating with the forwarder to have the collection take place on time and forwarding the necessary documents (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.) as agreed
 
• Communicating with the dealers to inform them of the delivery date provided and forward the transport documents needed.
 
• Alignment with various stakeholders in case of delivery issues and complaints
 
• Loading of pallets or cartons on trucks
 
• Acceptance of small shipments and organizing the internal transfer on site
 
• Administrative support to Logistics Transport Supervisor 
 
• Optimizing efficiency and costs for all shipments done
 

Interested in this challenging job?
 

Make your appointment online at www.konvert.be send your CV to leuven.interim@konvert.be 

 
• Deep Knowledge and experience in transport (minimum 3 years)
 
• Deep Knowledge of SAP transport module
 
• Knowledge of customs regulations is a plus
 
• Knowledge of Dangerous goods regulations (IATA, ADR regulations)
 
• Great command of Dutch & English, French is nice to have
 
• Advanced in MS Office - Excel, Word, Outlook
 
• Able to work from 08:00-16:30
 
• Strong communication skills
 
• Positive mindset and motivated attitude

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.

• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  

• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  

• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are currently hiring an Operations Line Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams.Your job:Reporting to the Operations Manager, you lead assembly, disassembly, and inspection teams within a high-performance aerospace environment. You ensure daily workshop operations run safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with customer, aviation, and Safran standards. Your focus is on delivering engine shop visit milestones on time while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety.Main tasks and responsibilities:

Operations & Planning

• Translate weekly production plans into daily priorities
• Manage shop floor activities to achieve on-time delivery
• Allocate workforce and resources efficiently
• Coordinate with planning and support teams
Team Leadership

• Lead and coach Team Leaders, Mechanics and Inspectors
• Drive training and performance improvement
• Support recruitment and development
• Foster teamwork and accountability
Safety & Quality

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards
• Promote a strong safety culture
• Ensure adherence to aviation quality standards
• Participate in audits and corrective actions
Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Monitor performance using QRQC
• Identify and implement improvements
• Manage quality deviations
• Optimize processes and operations

Your profile:You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.

• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have proven strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Encore Pro Group builds software for live entertainment and culture. With Encore Pro and Yesplan, venues and event organisers manage their operations and connect with audiences. Our products serve theatres, concert halls and event venues across the Benelux, and our group is growing in Europe, the UK, the United States and beyond. We have engineering labs in Ghent and Edinburgh, and offices in London, Reykjavik and New York.
 

We are looking for an Accounting Specialist to support our international group. You will combine hands-on bookkeeping with financial reporting and help improve the way we work across entities, countries and systems.

· A degree in accounting, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and relevant bookkeeping or accounting experience.
 

· A sound understanding of reconciliations and closing processes, with a careful, reliable and structured approach to deadlines.
 

· Strong Excel skills and confidence with accounting software; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.
 

· Strong English communication skills; additional languages are welcome.
 

· The ability to work independently and collaborate with an international team. Experience with multiple entities, intercompany accounting or subscription-based businesses is a plus.
 

· A practical, proactive mindset and an interest in process improvement and automation.

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Lead the migration of HR processes into the Shared Service Centre, including documentation, training, and go-live activities.

• Act as the main point of contact for HR leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and status reporting.

• Drive change management, communication, and training initiatives to support successful adoption.

• Establish performance metrics, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement programs to enhance service quality.

 

We are looking for an experienced HR transformation professional who can lead the design and implementation of a new HR Shared Service Centre in an international environment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.

• At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR Shared Service Centres.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, international HR transformation or shared services projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills.

• Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

• Sales & Customer service support:

As a GL Accountant, you will be responsible for managing and monitoring the accounting activities of one or more entities within the organization. You will ensure accurate financial reporting and contribute to smooth accounting processes.
 

Your main responsibilities include:
 
 

•  

Performing balance sheet analyses and monthly reconciliations.
  

•  

Preparing and supporting monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closings.
  

•  

Preparing financial reports for internal management and group reporting purposes.
  

•  

Monitoring and reviewing costs, accruals, and provisions.
  

•  

Participating in the annual budgeting process.
  

•  

Supporting and coordinating external audits.
  

•  

Working closely with the controlling department and international colleagues.
  
 

•  

You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  

•  

You have several years of relevant experience as a GL Accountant.
  

•  

You have a solid understanding of balance sheet analysis, financial closings, reconciliations, and IFRS.
  

•  

You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  

•  

Experience with SAP is considered an advantage.
  

•  

You are accurate, independent, and have strong analytical skills.
  

•  

You are a team player who enjoys working in an international environment.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and develop customer relationships across Eastern Europe.Our client is an international wholesaler specialising in industrial sealing solutions, including O-rings, technical seals and customised sealing products. The company supplies technical distributors and industrial trading partners worldwide.You will join a small, internationally oriented sales team where customer relationships, technical understanding and commercial initiative are equally important.Your focus will be on managing existing accounts while identifying opportunities to develop new business. Approximately 70% of your activities will involve existing customers, with the remaining 30% focused on new customer acquisition.What will you do? 
• Manage and develop relationships with existing B2B customers. 
• Identify potential customers and open new accounts. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative to develop sales opportunities. 
• Prepare quotations, calculate prices and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process customer orders and monitor their progress. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Identify cross-selling opportunities within the existing product range. 
• Encourage customers to use the company's digital ordering tools. 
• Handle customer enquiries, complaints and commercial requests. 
• Keep customer information accurate and up to date in the internal system. 
• Develop an understanding of customer applications, market developments and competitors. 
• Monitor commercial opportunities and report on sales activities. 
• Support colleagues when needed and contribute to the daily operation of the sales department.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have at least 4 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably involving technical products. 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong advantage. 
• Knowledge of French and/or Arabic is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and other business software. 
• You enjoy maintaining customer relationships and identifying commercial opportunities. 
• You communicate clearly and confidently with international customers. 
• You are organised and capable of managing several customer requests simultaneously. 
• You take initiative and follow up on commercial opportunities without needing constant supervision. 
• You work well in a small team and remain focused when priorities change. 
• An interest in industrial products and technical applications will help you succeed in this role.

Our client is a wholesale company based in Sint-Katelijne-Waver, specialized in the distribution of fresh fruit and vegetables in Belgium and the Netherlands.

For decades, this wholesale organization has been active in the fresh produce sector, using its knowledge and experience every day to search for opportunities, innovations, and top-quality products.

They can rightfully call themselves a leading player in the distribution, import, and export of fruit and vegetables.

Would you like to be part of their team?

Our client is looking for a motivated CE truck driver!

• Holder of a CE driving license with valid Code 95.
• Hard worker, committed to your job, with respect for customers, colleagues, and entrusted equipment.
• Not afraid of loading and unloading yourself.
• You will be the company’s calling card.
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?

Send us your CV today, and we’ll get to work for you!

REF:MEC

• CE driving license.
• Code 95.
• Initial experience in distribution is an asset.
• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays.
• Flexible, customer-oriented, and punctual.
• Flexible availability for both day and night shifts (both are required).
• Good knowledge of Dutch or French and English (understanding, writing, and speaking).

Job Function
 

The hired individual will be attached to the International and Institutional Affairs Department – Mobility and Congress, primarily responsible for administrative management of the department.
 

Tasks
 

Administering the management of the department's email inquiries and secretarial tasks.
 

Processing various documents.
 

Providing administrative support to team members.
 

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation
 

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.
 

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints
 

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators
 

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Requirements:
 

Bachelor's degree in administration
 

Proficient written and spoken English (minimum B2 level)
 

Minimum 2 years of experience in administration
 

Excellent spelling and grammar
 

Ability to analyze and synthesize information
 

Organizational skills, attention to detail, dynamism, adaptability to priorities, and flexibility
 

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team
 

Proficiency in computer tools (MS Office)
 

Knowledge of the academic and research world
